verdict.rationale: RustDesk's docs say connections use end-to-end encryption based on NaCl, which names the cryptographic basis. The pack has no actual protocol specification (key exchange, handshake, relay trust model), so this is close to an assertion, not documentation. One hands-on self-hosting report warns that encryption is not enabled by default, which further qualifies the claim. Missing for 10: published protocol documentation (key exchange, authentication, relay handling), confirmation that encryption is on by default including in self-hosted deployments, independent audit or corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sessions are encrypted end to end with the protocol documented, not just asserted

citations.quote: P2P connection with end-to-end encryption based on NaCl.
